pdfResources.title: Placement Readiness Program – Complete Schedule & Self-Evaluation Scheme (2026–2027)
pdfResources.subject: Career Development & Employability Skills
pdfResources.description:
This document presents the complete schedule and self-evaluation scheme for the Placement Readiness Program organized by KEY OF SUCCESS. Designed for Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) students, the program covers technical training, practical learning, assessments, project development, communication skills, hackathon participation and mock interview preparation.

The schedule includes learning sessions on Figma, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ReactJS, NextJS, Java, DSA, MySQL, MongoDB, Supabase and Python, followed by graded assessments and full-stack project development activities.

The program also emphasizes aptitude preparation, presentation skills, professional development, corporate readiness and AI-assisted mock interviews. The schedule runs from November 2026 to June 2027.
